name: broken-link-auditor
title: Broken Link & URL Status Auditor
description: Check the HTTP status of a list of URLs, a sitemap or a whole site crawl. Returns the final status, the redirect chain, loops, response time and content type, and for crawls the source page and anchor text of every link.
